values.note: 2026 rates (one rate for everyone, no resident split), 1-6 people: RV dry site $30 a night, electric (30-amp) site $35; tent sites $28 ($30 for sites 5, 10, 20 and 25); group sites $50 for up to 8 people, +$2 a person beyond. A second tent on larger sites costs extra. Showers 50 cents for 3 minutes.

RV Dry Sites - $30.-/night (1 – 6 people). Showers are .50 for 3 minutes') + https://www.leelanau.gov/townships/empire/services/campground.php ('Electric site (30 AMP) $35+/night'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 60 sites in two wooded sections (Hardwoods and Pine Tree): 9 with electricity, RV dry sites, tent sites and 3 group sites. One tent/camper and one vehicle per site.

sites.source: https://www.leelanau.gov/townships/empire/services/campground.php ('The 60-site rustic campground ... is divided into two sections, known as the Hardwoods Section and the Pine Tree Section, and features 9 campsites with electricity and 3 group sites') + 2026 rules ('One tent/camper per site'; 'One vehicle is allowed per site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Coin-operated showers, one flush toilet beside the drinking-water station, outhouses and drinking water throughout, dump station, ice. No generators or chainsaws allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.leelanau.gov/townships/empire/services/campground.php ('Coin-operated showers, one flush toilet, and ice are available. Outhouses and drinking water are located throughout the campground.') + 2026 rules ('All other containers must be dumped at the dump station'; 'No chainsaws or generators are permitted in the campground'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.leelanau.gov/townships/empire/services/campground.php ('The Empire Township Campground is open from May 15 to September 15'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve by emailing empiretownshipcampground@gmail.com with dates, party size, rig type and size; full payment for stays of 5 nights or less, a one-night deposit per week otherwise. Register at the office before setting up. Cancelling 5+ business days out costs one night (per week reserved); inside 4 business days the whole stay.

booking.source: https://www.leelanau.gov/townships/empire/services/campground.php ('Email your reservation request with the following information to empiretownshipcampground@gmail.com'; payment and cancellation terms) + 2026 rules ('You MUST register at the office before setting up camp'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Empire Township campground in the woods at 264 W Osborn Rd, 5 miles from the Village of Empire and the Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore headquarters. Fills on holidays. --Claude
